landing.heroKicker: A calmer day on the farm
landing.heroTitle: Make every farm decision with more confidence.
landing.heroBody: Namma Rytha brings weather, irrigation, soil health, crop checks, and market rates together in one simple workspace for Indian farmers.
landing.proofOneText: for the decisions that matter every day
landing.proofTwoText: with local crops, weather, and market context
landing.sectionBody: Bring your daily farm signals into one clear view, so you can spend less time switching between apps and more time acting at the right moment.
landing.irrigateText: Combine soil moisture and rain probability to decide when to water—and when to wait.
landing.cropText: Upload a crop photo for a careful first check, with low-confidence cases flagged for review.
landing.sellText: See nearby mandi rates and recent movement before planning your next sale.
landing.howTitle: A clearer rhythm for every season.
landing.howBody: Set up your farm once. Namma Rytha keeps the useful signals close at hand, even when the network is not.
landing.stepOneText: Choose your location, crops, and plots.
landing.stepTwoText: Weather, moisture, tasks, and market signals in one view.
landing.stepThreeText: Use simple recommendations and keep a history over time.
landing.ctaTitle: Give your farm a calmer, clearer day.
landing.footer: Built for farmers. Designed for real field conditions.
